In this first week, we will cover course goals, the structure and assignments from the course, the timing of labs, and then introduce a brief history of marine ecology.

## ✍️ Coursework

Check out Chapter 1 of MCEC to learn about the [history of marine ecology](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/MCEC_01_history_of_mar_eco.pdf) - not required, but gives a great intro!
